black_cardamom.common_uses: Used in savory dishes, curries, and garam masala.
black_cardamom.key_visual_features: Large, dark brown to black, ribbed outer skin.

black_pepper.common_uses: Universal seasoning, marinades, and spice blends.

cumin.common_uses: Curries, tempering (tadka), and roasted spice blends.

dagad_phool.flavor_profile: Mild, woody, and earthy aroma when roasted.
dagad_phool.common_uses: Meat dishes, biryanis, and goda masala.
dagad_phool.key_visual_features: Dry, papery, lichen-like appearance with dark and light gray shades.

dhaniya.common_uses: Curries, pickles, and ground spice blends.

dried_coconut.key_visual_features: White to off-white curved pieces or shreds with a brown outer layer.

chilli_byadgi.flavor_profile: Mildly spicy, earthy, and imparts bright red color.
chilli_byadgi.common_uses: Bisi bele bath, sambar, and colorful curries.

chilli_guntur.key_visual_features: Bright red, moderately long, and smooth-skinned.

chilli_lavangi.common_uses: Maharashtrian spicy dishes and Kolhapuri cuisine.
chilli_lavangi.key_visual_features: Very small, thin, and bright red.

chilli_sankeshwari.flavor_profile: Moderate to high heat, bright orange-red color.
chilli_sankeshwari.common_uses: Fish curries and coastal Maharashtra cuisine.

elaichi_dana.common_uses: Directly added to sweets and spice mixes.
elaichi_dana.key_visual_features: Tiny, sticky, dark brown to black seeds.

halkund.common_uses: Ground for general cooking, pickles, and religious ceremonies.
